ABOUT

/About the company

Online Therapy Ontario is a growing psychotherapy practice based in Ontario, Canada. It offers virtual mental health support for individuals, couples and families.

It was founded by registered psychotherapist Darren Elliott and is growing into a group practice. Its focus is relational trauma and narcissism, inclusive support for BIPOC and 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, and accessible online care across the province.

Its connected projects are The Narcissism Recovery Project, the book The United States of Disconnection, the Love Loops™ practices, and Darren's drag persona Doreen Devine (Friends of Doreen).

SCOPE

/My role & scope

For a year I worked full-time and remotely as Darren Elliott's digital marketing and executive assistant. I handled the content, websites and books for the practice and its projects, plus the admin that keeps a therapy practice running.

  • Planned and posted 10–12 times a week across Online Therapy Ontario, The Narcissism Recovery Project and Friends of Doreen
  • Kept content calendars in Asana and scheduled through Meta Business Suite
  • Kept every post on brand, with respectful and accurate wording on mental health and 2SLGBTQIA+ topics
  • Designed carousels, check-in prompts and promo graphics in Canva, like the Meet the Therapist series
  • Edited reels and YouTube videos in CapCut and Descript: captions, title pages and music
  • Created video thumbnails with AI image tools
  • Built the Online Therapy Ontario and The Narcissism Recovery Project websites in Squarespace, then kept both updated
  • Prepared and published 40+ blog posts
  • Created CRPO-compliant website materials
  • Designed and edited The United States of Disconnection and uploaded it to Amazon KDP
  • Designed the Love Loops™ Companion Guide and Facilitator's Guide
  • Kept print and digital formats consistent, and marketed the book
  • Created 8+ CRPO-compliant worksheets and reflection pages
  • Built email campaigns in Mailchimp
  • Handled scheduling, billing and client communications in Jane App for all of the practice's clients
  • Managed the inbox and calendar in Google Workspace
  • Booked Darren's Doreen Devine drag gigs and connected him with collaborators
